{{Top|leg}}
The '''LV-F deflector shield''' was a type of [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]] system produced by [[Prexton]] during the the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The LV-F had a low total stopping power until its "fortress" program was activated, which would then generate a significant boost to shield strength as long as the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] remained still and did not accelerate.
